create_composepair: create a ComposePair transform to apply a sequence of paired transforms on two images
build_normalizeboth: build a NormalizeBoth transform to normalize two images with the same mean and std values
create_totensorboth: create a ToTensorBoth transform to convert two PIL images into PyTorch tensors simultaneously
build_randomcroppair: build a RandomCropPair transform to independently crop two images to a specified size
use_get_pair_transforms: use get_pair_transforms to build a paired image transform pipeline from a string like crop224+acolor
